```python
purchase_insurance(
    access_token="YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN",
    insurance_type="Comprehensive",   # 綜合保障

    booking_id="<BOOKING_ID>",        # 已取得的航班編號
    card_id="crd6789"                 # 信用卡編號
)
```
